texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船成功地从[From.GetStarName]星系里的奇特干扰中分离出了一个信号。信号的内容是一首歌。确切来说，是一首由复杂数学方程式构成的歌，而且[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]似乎无法不去想它。

是谁或者是什么东西写了这首歌仍不得而知，不过其复杂程度暗示着对子空间和声学的高度精通。信号的测地线表明其来源位于我们的星系之外。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has succeeded in isolating a signal embedded within the unusual pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] system. The signal is a song. A complex sonification of an advanced mathematical equation to be precise, and one that [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] cannot seem to get out of their mind.

Who or what may have composed this song remains unknown, though its complexity infers an incredible level of technological sophistication regarding subspace harmonics. The signal's geodesics suggest a point of origin from outside of our galaxy.

summary.text:
# 干扰 / Interference

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:900-920; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:10039 (distar.265); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1141-1180 (distar.9000 sonic text)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。任意恒星可能生成（1级，权重1，每个帝国一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on any star (level 1, weight 1, once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.265“声化科学”：干扰中藏着一首歌——一个高等数学方程的声化表达，信号的测地线指向银河系之外。奖励社会学与物理学研究，并设置 lcluster_clue_sonic 标记。结果执行 pop_lcluster_event：若已遇到首座L星门且线索未集齐，有30%几率在10天后触发通用的 distar.9000“L星门见解”（另一故事）。若 distar.9000 因此出现，会使用与这首“歌”相关的专门文本。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.265 "Sonified Science": the interference hides a song — the sonification of an advanced equation whose geodesics point to an origin outside the galaxy. Rewards society and physics research and sets lcluster_clue_sonic. The result runs pop_lcluster_event: if the empire has met its first L-Gate and the clues are incomplete, there is a 30% chance of the generic distar.9000 "L-Gate Insights" 10 days later (a separate story). If distar.9000 then fires it uses a dedicated text about this song. The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

狂热净化者只看到“令人不安”选项，效果相同。

Fanatic Purifiers only see "Disconcerting"; same effects.
